## 1. 共通データのセット

```{r}

rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# libraries needed
library(tidyverse)  # most variable creation here uses tidyverse 
library(tidyselect) # used to select variables in FP_EVENTS.R
library(haven)      # used for Haven labeled DHS variables
library(labelled)   # used for Haven labeled variable creation
library(expss)      # for creating tables with Haven labeled data
library(rJava)      # required for xlsx package
library(naniar)     # to use replace_with_na function
library(here)       # to get R project path
library(fs)         # for file path manipulation
library(openxlsx) 　# for exporting to excel
library(survey)       # for survey design


# 各種の関数セット読み込み
source("../myTools.R")  # プロジェクトルートから読み込む（quarto限定の処理）

# 対象とする年のリスト
yearlist <- c("2007", "2008", "2009", "2010", "2011",
"2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016")
# yearlist <- c("2015")

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

# データベース一覧

endes_list <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","endes_data_list.rds"))

```

## 2. データ処理

```{r}
# 必要なデータセットの抽出

# ソースコードのルートフォルダを指定
chap <- "Chap02_PH"

goAnalysis <- function(year){
  
  # 母親の雇用状態を追加
  keep_RECH23 <- c("hhid", "hv201", "hv201a", "hv204", "hv205", "hv206", "hv207",
                  "hv208", "hv209", "hv210", "hv211", "hv213", "hv216", "hv221", 
                  "hv225", "hv226", "hv237", "hv237a", "hv237b", "hv237c", "hv237d", 
                  "hv237e", "hv237f", "hv237g", "hv237h", "hv237i", "hv237j", 
                  "hv237k", "hv237x", "hv241", "hv241z", "hv243a", "hv243c", 
                  "hv243d", "hv244", "hv246")
  keep_RECH0 <- c("hhid", "hv000", "hv005", "hv006", "hv007")

  # 設定した年に基づいてファイルを読み込む
  df_REC23 <- open_endes_file(year, "RECH23.sav") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_RECH23) %>% dplyr::select(all_of(keep_RECH23))
  df_REC0 <- open_endes_file(year, "RECH0.sav") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_RECH0) %>% dplyr::select(all_of(keep_RECH0))

  # 重複チェック
  duplicate_check(df_REC23, c("hhid"), "REC23")
  duplicate_check(df_REC0, c("hhid"), "REC0")

  print("データセットを結合します")
  HRdata <- df_REC23 %>%
    left_join(df_REC0, by = c("hhid" = "hhid")) %>%
    mutate(year = year)

  print("データセットの結合が完了しました")
  print(paste("レコード数:", nrow(HRdata)))

  source(here(paste0(chap,"/PH_HOUS.R")), local = environment())
  # Purpose:	Code housing indicators such as house material, assets, cooking fuel and place, and smoking in the home
  
  WASHdata <- HRdata
  source(here(paste0(chap,"/PH_SANI.R")), local = environment())
  # Purpose: 	Code Sanitation indicators
  
  source(here(paste0(chap,"/PH_WATER.R")), local = environment())
  # Purpose: 	Code Water Source indicators
  
  # WASHdataから必要な変数を選択
  vars_to_keep <- WASHdata %>%
    dplyr::select(starts_with("ph")) %>%
    names() %>%
    append(c("hhid")) # add the variables we need to keep
      
  WASHdata <- WASHdata[, vars_to_keep]

  # 出力用のルートフォルダを指定
  output_dir <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws() # 正規化してトリムする
  # 出力用のルートフォルダが存在しない場合は作成
  if (!dir_exists(output_dir)) {
    dir_create(output_dir)
  }
  
  # WASHdata folderにrds形式で保存
  print(sprintf("save WASHdata into output folder for %s", year))
  print("WASHdata")
  saveRDS(WASHdata, paste0(output_dir, "/WASHdata-ws.rds"))
  print("complete WASHdata into output folder")
  
}

```

## 3. ループ実行

```{r}
#** ここから実行
for (yr in yearlist) {
  goAnalysis(yr)
}
```
